privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Ember Cash is a personal finance app in test mode. Here is what data we keep and what we do with it, plain and simple.
privacy.dataIntro: Only what you type into the app:
privacy.purposeBody: Only to make the app work. Nothing else.
privacy.whoBody: You and the members of your household. No one else can see it inside the app.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use a single cookie, the session cookie, to keep you signed in. We don't use analytics or advertising cookies.
privacy.providersBody: To run the app we use Supabase (database and sign-in) and Vercel (hosting). Their servers may be outside Colombia, so your data may be stored or processed in other countries.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, you can:
privacy.right1: Know what data we have about you.
privacy.sharedBody: If you delete your account, the expenses you shared with your household stay so the other members can keep their books straight, but without your name or email: they show up as Deleted user.
privacy.deleteBody: Go to Settings and choose Delete account. You can export your data as CSV first.
privacy.betaBody: This is a beta for friends. While you test it, use made-up numbers.
privacy.contactBody: For questions, complaints or data deletion, write to {contactEmail}.
privacy.changesBody: If this notice changes, we will update the version and the date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These are the basic rules for using Ember Cash. They are short on purpose.
terms.betaBody: Ember Cash is a beta. It is provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or never fail.
terms.adviceBody: Ember Cash does not give financial, accounting or tax advice. Decisions about your money are yours.
terms.ageBody: Only people over 18 may use the app.
terms.testBody: While this is a beta, we recommend using made-up numbers.
terms.noChargesBody: We don't charge anything and we don't connect to your bank. Everything you see is what you typed.
terms.useIntro: By using Ember Cash, you agree to:
terms.use1: Not use it for anything illegal.
terms.use2: Not try to access other people's data.
terms.use3: Not damage or overload the service.
terms.use4: Keep your account and password safe.
terms.changeBody: We may change, pause or shut down Ember Cash at any time. If that happens, we will try to warn you in time so you can export your data.
terms.contactBody: Write to {contactEmail} if you have questions.

settings.backupBody: Downloads a ZIP with one CSV per table. Amounts are integers in minor units (pesos for COP, cents for USD) and each row keeps its currency.
settings.backupRestore: There is no automatic import. To restore, keep the identifiers and load the rows again in this order: profiles, households, members, departures, accounts, goals, debts, recurring items, transactions, splits, contributions, payments, occurrences, budgets and settlements. If the file includes TRUNCATED.txt, the download is incomplete. A full project backup lives in Supabase, under Database then Backups.

designSystem.title: Ember Cash design system
designSystem.intro: Tokens (Light / Dark), type, components and icons. Showing the {theme} theme. All figures are sample data.
designSystem.colorTokens: Color tokens (light swatch front, dark behind)
designSystem.icons: Icons (Uicons by Flaticon: regular rounded, solid rounded)
designSystem.iconsAttribution: Uicons designed by Flaticon from Flaticon. The free licence requires this visible attribution.
designSystem.statesIntro: Focus ring: 2 px #BD490A (dark #FF9552), offset 2 px. Pressed: scale 0.97. Sample data only.
designSystem.emptyDescription: Add your first transaction or import a bank file to see your month take shape.
designSystem.loadingNote: Skeleton matches final row geometry; shimmer is static under reduced motion.
designSystem.toastNote: Toast replaces a confirmation dialog; stays 6 s, Undo restores the item.
designSystem.freshNote: Fetched today. Converted amounts show with the chip's date.
designSystem.staleNote: Older than 24 h: amber chip with the old date. Converted amounts stay, tooltip says 'rate from {date}'. Click refreshes.
designSystem.updatingNote: Chip keeps its width. Numbers do not move; converted lines dim to 60% until done.
designSystem.errorNote: Rate not available: originals stay primary, each converted line reads 'rate unavailable' instead of a stale number.
designSystem.pointerNote: Press and hold 2 s, fill sweeps left to right. Release cancels.
designSystem.keyboardNote: Same fill and focus ring. Releasing the key or Esc cancels. Screen reader: '{hint}'.
designSystem.twoStepNote: Second press within 4 s, then a toast with Undo (6 s) before the delete is final.
designSystem.contrastNote: Label contrast: ink on the red fill is 10.45 (light) / 9.69 (dark); red text on the fill was 3.29 / 3.64 and was replaced.
designSystem.moneyNote: The selected currency comes first; the original goes below only if it differs. ≈ appears only in totals. Hover an amount to see the rate.
